subject: general
question: Which of the following is a temple in Mangaluru, dedicated to an avatar of Lord Shiva?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kadri Manjunatha Temple.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kadri Manjunatha Temple is a historic temple in Mangalore in the state of Karnataka, India dedicated to Lord Shiva.**
 
• **Kadri Manjunatheshwara temple is one of the ancient historical temples dating back to about 1068 A.D.**
 
• The Manjunatha temple, Kadri belongs to the **Vijayanagara style of structure.**
 
• **The earliest reference to this place is in the epigraph dated A.D.968 engraved on the pedestal of the famous Lokeshwara image**.
 
• It is mentioned that** King Kundavarma of the Alupa Dynasty installed the image in Kadarika Vihara. From this, we can know that Kadarika is the earliest form of this place's name.**
 
• **Vihara is the name given in Buddhlet settlement **while Buddhism flourished here during 10th century A.D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mukteshvara Temple**

 
 
• **​Mukteshwara Temple is a 10th-century Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India**.
 
• The temple dates back to 950–975 CE and is a monument of importance in the study of the development of Hindu temples in Odisha.
 
• **The Mukteshwar temple is believed to be one of the 18 important Shiva temples.**
 
 
 
• **Ananta Vasudeva Temple​**
 
 
• **Ananta Vasudeva Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Krishna, an avatar of Vishnu located in Bhubaneswar, the state capital of Odisha, India.**
 
• The temple was **constructed in the thirteenth century, and the complete murtis of Krishna, Balarama, and Subhadra** are worshipped there.
 
 
 
• **Gundicha Temple ****​**
 
 
• **​Gundicha Temple is a Hindu temple, situated in the temple town of Puri in the state of Odisha, India.**
 
• It is **significant for being the destination of the celebrated annual Rath Yatra of Puri.**
 
 

167:T1
